Welcome—I'm so glad you're here.
Have you ever wondered what it would be like to step inside a world where imagination has no limits, and gentle humor lights the way?
That’s exactly where Jim Henson takes us—a place built on creativity, innovation, and the courage to dream big.
Through the eyes of Brian Jay Jones, we get to travel alongside Henson as he brings unforgettable characters like Kermit the Frog and Miss Piggy to life.
But it’s so much more than just puppetry, isn’t it?
We’ll discover how Henson’s relentless passion for artistic expression—and his love of collaboration—sparked an entire movement in entertainment.
Together, we’ll explore the highs and lows: from humble beginnings to worldwide acclaim, from the rise of the Muppets and the magic of Sesame Street, to the bold adventures into film and television.
Along the way, we’ll get a glimpse behind the curtain—into the joys, the struggles, and the personal values that shaped not just a career, but a legacy.
What really makes Henson’s story unforgettable is the way his life continues to encourage us—to be curious, to be kind, and to believe that anything is possible if we dare to imagine.
So, let’s set off on this journey together. There’s so much magic waiting for us to uncover.
